descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you an analytical person interested in working with data and improving internal processes? We are looking for an intern to join our Process & Quality Specialists team, supporting process automation and data-driven insights:
• preparation and automation of internal reports
• automation of internal control routines and operational processes
• support for the team’s daily activities
